title: Middle East war live: Chinese, South Korean oil tankers pass through Strait of Hormuz
summary: Three oil tankers – two Chinese and one South Korean – crossed the Strait of Hormuz Wednesday, according to maritime tracking data, as Iran threatened to open “new fronts” if the US resumed strikes. President Donald Trump is set to attend the G7 summit in France next month, despite tensions between Washington and its allies on the Iran war. Follow our liveb…
